entries.speaker: Soft-Spoken Male Student
entries.en: Well, there's our student council[n]president.

entries.speaker: Soft-Spoken Male Student
entries.en: Is she reading all those huge, complex[n]books to study for college exams?[n]That's really intimidating.

entries.speaker: Book-Loving Male Student
entries.en: She borrowed a sci-fi book the other[n]day though. Maybe we have something[n]in common.

entries.speaker: Soft-Spoken Male Student
entries.en: Oh, I'm sure, but she'd never talk to[n]people like us. She's too driven and[n]serious.
entries.uk: О, звісно, але з такими, як ми, вона[n]ніколи не заговорить. Вона надто[n]цілеспрямована й серйозна.

entries.speaker: Soft-Spoken Male Student
entries.en: That's why she's always getting top[n]grades. I can see why the principal[n]put so much hope in her.
entries.uk: Тому в неї завжди найкращі оцінки.[n]Зрозуміло, чому директор покладає[n]на неї такі надії.

entries.speaker: Soft-Spoken Male Student
entries.en: Hm? The student council president[n]isn't here today. She's usually always[n]there, studying.
entries.uk: Га? Голови учнівської ради сьогодні[n]нема. Зазвичай вона завжди тут,[n]вчиться.

entries.speaker: Book-Loving Male Student
entries.en: Maybe she's busy because of that[n]Kamoshida thing. The principal's[n]antsy about it too, I hear.
entries.uk: Може, вона зайнята через ту історію[n]з Камошідою. Кажуть, директор[n]теж через це нервує.

entries.speaker: Soft-Spoken Male Student
entries.en: They're probably looking for who put[n]up that flyer, but they should be taking[n]more care of us.
entries.uk: Мабуть, шукають, хто повісив ту[n]листівку, а краще б більше дбали[n]про нас.

entries.speaker: Book-Loving Male Student
entries.en: I guess it's disappointing that even the[n]student council president is at the[n]teacher's beck and call.
entries.uk: Трохи прикро, що навіть голова[n]учнівської ради бігає на побігеньках[n]у вчителів.

entries.speaker: Soft-Spoken Male Student
entries.en: What's the student council president[n]been doing? She's acting pretty[n]suspiciously.
entries.uk: Що там робить голова учнівської[n]ради? Вона поводиться доволі[n]підозріло.

entries.speaker: Soft-Spoken Male Student
entries.en: Wandering school, sneaking around...[n]I saw her hanging out in Shibuya for[n]some reason too.
entries.uk: Тиняється школою, крадеться...[n]Я чомусь бачив її ще й[n]у Шібуї.

entries.speaker: Book-Loving Male Student
entries.en: She was acting just like a detective,[n]working on a case. Maybe she thinks[n]she is one?

entries.speaker: Book-Loving Male Student
entries.en: She did check out some detective[n]novels the other day. Maybe she's[n]just really into detectives now.
entries.uk: Днями вона брала кілька детективів.[n]Може, вона просто зараз захоплюється[n]детективами.

entries.en: She must be really focused...[n]She didn't notice me at all.
entries.uk: Вона, мабуть, дуже зосереджена...[n]Зовсім мене не помітила.

entries.speaker: Diligent-Looking Student
entries.en: Mr. Kamoshida locked himself[n]away after that prank with those[n]"phantom thieves"...
entries.uk: Пан Камошіда замкнувся в собі після[n]того розіграшу з тими «фантомними[n]злодіями»...

entries.speaker: Diligent-Looking Student
entries.en: And on top of that, we have midterms[n]coming up after the break. I wonder[n]how next semester is going to go...
entries.uk: А ще після канікул проміжні іспити.[n]Цікаво, яким буде наступний[n]семестр...

entries.speaker: Diligent-Looking Student
entries.en: Hey, isn't that the transfer[n]student? What's he doing here?

entries.speaker: Diligent-Looking Student

entries.uk: Це ж той, що із судимістю?[n]Якого біса він робить[n]у бібліотеці?

entries.speaker: Diligent-Looking Student
entries.en: Oh no, why did he have to[n]coem here? He's terrifying...

entries.speaker: Diligent-Looking Student

entries.uk: Кажуть, він потайний садист...[n]І, чесно, на вигляд[n]саме такий.

entries.speaker: Diligent-Looking Student
entries.en: Can he even read?

entries.speaker: Diligent-Looking Student

entries.speaker: Diligent-Looking Student
entries.en: Oh crap, he totally glared[n]at me. I hope he doesn't[n]come over here...

entries.speaker: Diligent-Looking Student
entries.en: He acts normal, but you[n]can tell he's messed up...

entries.speaker: Diligent-Looking Student
entries.en: He's got the eyes[n]of a convict...
entries.uk: У нього очі[n]каторжника...

entries.speaker: Diligent-Looking Student
entries.en: He has to leave before[n]he causes more trouble...

entries.speaker: Diligent-Looking Student

entries.speaker: Diligent-Looking Student
entries.en: You think he'll lose his shit[n]before he gets kicked out?

entries.speaker: Diligent-Looking Student

entries.speaker: Diligent-Looking Student
